title: Custom Lipstick or Lip Gloss Creation Experience
includes: Creation of one custom lipstick or lip gloss.
Materials and equipment to create one custom lipstick or lip gloss
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Unleash your creativity at Lip Print Beauty Bar, where you can personalize your very own lipstick or lip gloss. Guided by skilled Lip Artists, choose from an array of bases and pigments to craft a unique shade that reflects your style. Enhance your creation with special add-ons like scents and glitter, then finish by making your unique lip print and naming your masterpiece. This engaging experience is perfect for solo dates, girls night out, bridal showers, bachelorette parties, and birthdays, allowing you to indulge in a fun, memorable activity with friends. Transform your vision into a reality and let your lips be the canvas for your artistry.
